Hi Jonas (and team),

Thanks for submitting the SIG workbook last week. We're reviewing your Incident Response (IR) answers and need a couple of clarifications before we finish the questionnaire:

- In your answer to 6.2 (Breach Notification), you reference regulator notification within 72 hours and customer notification within 30 days. Can you confirm whether those are hard SLAs or illustrative timelines?
- Who are the operational contacts we should notify for an incident affecting customer data (email + phone)? Please confirm the escalation roster and whether there are regional contacts for EU incidents.

We'd like to close this section by the end of the week; if it's easier, can we schedule a 20-minute call to run through these items? I've also attached the SIG workbook with inline comments.

Thanks,

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and for the inline comments on the workbook. We're happy to clarify.

Quick answers up front:
- 72 hours to regulators is our standard target for incidents that meet local regulatory thresholds (we rely on Legal to confirm whether a given incident meets those thresholds). It's not an automated SLA but an operational target in our playbook.
- Customer notifications are typically sent after initial triage and customer-impact assessment; our target is within 30 days for incidents that materially affect customer data, but we aim to communicate earlier if there is confirmed impact.
- Operational contacts: see internal note below — Neha, can you please provide the latest IR roster and confirm EU contacts? Marissa: tagging you for any legal/regulatory caveats.

I'd be open to a quick call — I can do 11:30–12:00 PT tomorrow.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-11-17T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG: Clarification on breach notification windows (internal)

Jonas / Marissa — attaching the most recent IR roster (IR_roster_v3.pdf). Highlights:

- Primary ops contact (US): ir-ops@redwood.com (monitored 24/7), escalation: Neha Kapoor (mobile: +1-415-555-0123).
- Secondary ops contact (EMEA): hiro_tanaka@redwood.com, escalation: mina_haddad@redwood.com.
- Legal/regulatory: marissa_cole@redwood.com (primary), stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com (backup).
- We treat the 72-hour regulator window as an obligation only when required by law/contract; if an incident triggers a reportable breach under GDPR, we target 72 hours for supervisory authority notification. For contractual/customer notification, we default to \"notify when impact is confirmed\" and aim for a 30-day cadence for full customer communications.

Notes and caveats:
- For incidents involving third-party processors, we coordinate timelines with the processor. If their contract contains faster notice requirements we surface those to Legal for escalation.
- For critical incidents that affect production availability and customer SLAs, we may push an initial customer advisory within 24 hours even if detailed findings are pending (high-level facts + next steps).

Attaching: IR_roster_v3.pdf (names/phones), and linking our playbook: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_IR_Playbook

-Neha
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
